senses.definition: The material in which something is wrapped.

quotes.text: Cattle are shot with stones and can only be cured by a "fairy dart" or ancient stone arrowhead. These objects are kept in numerous wrappings by every properly qualified "fairy doctor," who rub[s] them on the sick beasts with appropriate charms ...

senses.definition: (computing, writing) The breaking of a section of text into lines so that it will fit into the available width of a display area.
examples: See also: autowrap, backwrap, line break, word wrap, and wraparound

senses.definition: present participle and gerund of wrap
